newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise margins on July "C" coffee futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise margins on July "C" coffee futures.

text.p: The Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Tuesday it will raise margins on the July "C" coffee contract by $1,000 to $5,500, effective March 19.
The margins on the spot May "C" coffee contract, however, were unchanged at $6,500, the exchange said in a statement.
Margins on all other coffee contracts will remain at $4,500, the CSCE added.
The changes comes just one day after the exchange raised the spot May margin by $1,000 and the margins on all other contracts by $500.
In addition, straddle or arbitrage transactions will require a minimum of $1,500 for customers who are members or members of the trade.
The $2,000 spot charge for May 1997 and the $1,000 spot charge for July 1997 are applicable to all straddle and arbitrage transactions involving these months, the exchange said.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said.
